purpose: Report information or state the meaning inferred from it.
keywords: Plain form + ということだ
I hear the shop will close next month.
If there is no reply, that means it has not been decided yet.
So that means everyone agreed, right?
formation: Plain form + ということだ
restrictions: Can introduce hearsay or summarize what a situation implies; context separates them.
mistake: Do not automatically treat every occurrence as a reported quotation.
